result.summary: The page is generally clean, but a few visual issues stand out: a restaurant card is clipped at the bottom, a horizontal card is truncated on the right, and favorite heart icons can be hard to see on light images.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, showing only the top half and hiding its name and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom tab bar, or provide a clearer scroll affordance.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is truncated at the right screen edge, and the restaurant name is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the horizontal carousel container so the peeked card and its text are not clipped against the screen edge.

issues.description: The white heart/favorite icons on restaurant images have low contrast against light areas of the food photos, such as the ramen eggs and pizza cheese.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle dark shadow, semi-transparent scrim, or contrasting stroke behind the heart icon so it remains visible across all image backgrounds.
